notes.title: The Last Alchemist, a new title from Vile Monarch, is now available!
notes.content:
Hey y'all!

We know you love [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1191120/]Growing Up[/url], so how about trying another title developed by [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/vilemonarch]Vile Monarch[/url] as well?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1536570/

Welcome to the wholesome science-fantasy world of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1536570/]The Last Alchemist[/url], a third-person alchemy simulation game about the blazing pursuit of science and friendship.

Embrace your weird and wonderful role as the world's last Alchemist! You will craft your workshop from the ground up, practice alchemy by solving puzzles, befriend and understand the Agari folk, and roam a vibrant world packed with brilliant resources to bring home and make use of.


BTW, if The Last Alchemist is your kind of game, or you just want to stay in touch for other future updates from Vile Monarch, give us a follow on the platform of your choice!

notes.title: Nominate Growing Up for The Steam Awards!
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

We’ve received over 800 reviews on Steam after releasing the new DLC! Thank you so much!

As 2021 comes to a close, that means it's time for the annual Steam Awards! We're delighted that our game has a chance to be nominated this year.

Initially, we considered going for Outstanding Visual Style or Best Soundtrack. After some debate, we finally decided to apply for the Sit Back and Relax category. We hope everyone can get relaxed when playing our game. :)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40297204/bea44fec0bc3b2627f70191c7a037c7f2dfa2736.png[/img]
But if you think our game deserves to be nominated for other award categories, that’s totally fine with us! If you haven't decided, please nominate Growing Up for the Sit Back and Relax Award ;-)

Last but not least 
Growing Up is 10% off during the Steam Autumn Sale! 

And as usual, we really hope you’ll enjoy our game as you relive the adventure of your childhood days.

PS:Due to the problem in the setting of steamworks, we could only choose the 'Labor of Love' category in options, we have only released this announcement after contacting valve to solve it. Sorry we're late.:)

Join the Growing Up community and follow us on Twitter and Facebook.

notes.title: Growing up’s New FREE DLC is available now!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We’re thrilled to announce that Growing Up’s new DLC is available today!
[b]You can get the new DLC content after update to the latest version! Enjoy.[/b]

The new DLC adds 2 new unusual jobs with unique skill trees:

[b]Bowler[/b]

You can now head down to The Alley Way, find the perfect ball, and give bowling a try. Can you become a pro bowler or proud owner of multiple titles?

[b]Magician[/b]

The secret of magic is another mysterious path to follow. Under the wings of equally mysterious and extravagant Daz, you will track down the secrets of magic and illusion to develop your own spectacular magic shows in dazzling theaters.



Besides these two careers, new endings, items, and skills await your discovery!

With the addition of this DLC, you can meet a total of 21 different pals for knowing, loving, and playing! The free DLC brings three new friends to your life:

[b]Jake[/b], a well-meaning but slightly troubled boy that can't help but get into all sorts of trouble.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40297204/52a5993bfe189c0ac2903010b290ddd8a112a1e8.png[/img]

[b]Bobbie[/b], a girl who lives for the spotlight! She’s always busy singing, acting, and performing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40297204/f4653eba08511cde15070278e06aea00abfabdab.png[/img]

[b]Charles[/b], meet “Hoffer”, a boy born into a political family who suffers from the conflicts between his family, identity, and sexual orientation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40297204/8d499b20873c1d0b9faa61b8a80ea735ba5c9533.png[/img]

After hearing your feedback, some amazing community items and the beautiful OST are now available on Steam.

You can see some of the community items here:

https://store.steampowered.com/points/shop/app/1191120

The soundtrack includes 30 original songs created by Jim Guthrie, Pat Robitaille, DJ Eprom, Mikromusic, and Paweł Wawrzeńczyk.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1817630/Growing_Up_Original_Soundtrack/

The console and mobile launch dates will be announced soon. We really hope you’ll enjoy our game as you relive the adventure of your childhood days!

If you have any feedback and would like to share with us, please reach us via the following methods:

[list]

[*] [url=https://discord.gg/DUCzWfdZUV]Discord[/url]

[*] [url=https://www.facebook.com/Growing-Up-102986898769017]Facebook[/url]

[*] [url=https://twitter.com/GrowingUp_game]Twitter[/url]

[/list]
 
Sincerely,

Vile Monarch

notes.title: FREE DLC coming November 24th!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40297204/b75c5795c03c7d267a3f4ec865a99a36a933ac0e.png[/img]

Hello there!

Growing Up has been out for a month. Over the past few days, we’ve received over 600 reviews. We’ve seen lots of great fan art and reviews are Very Positive right now on Steam. Thank you all very much for your support!

We’re excited to tell you that we will soon release [b]a new DLC on November 24th... and it’s FREE![/b]
We’ll also join Steam’s Autumn Sale to bring a 10% off discount for those of you who haven’t already bought Growing Up.

Other than the free DLC, we’re also giving out amazing community items and a beautiful OST with 30 original songs on November 24th!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1817630/Growing_Up_Original_Soundtrack

The new DLC contains 3 new classmates and 2 extra careers. You’ll be able to try your skills at magic and bowling as soon as the DLC is released.

Today we’re happy to introduce you to one of your new classmates, Bobbie!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40297204/849953df5f34a2daec1108517bd601e819fd0e49.jpg[/img]

Bobbie is a girl who lives for the spotlight! Always busy singing, acting, and performing. How will she react when others don't approve of her passion—especially when it's her own parents?

We’ll offer some peeks at more characters in the future, so stay turned! ;)

[h2]Balance changes:[/h2]
- Raised Mental Health and Parents' Satisfaction stats rebound after getting a Strike

- Lowered Grade Thresholds for Elementary, Middle School and High School Exams
- Lowered the Mental Health penalty for performing Tier 1, Tier 2 and Tier 3 Work Skills
- Reduced prices of certain foods

notes.title: Demo Available Now! Grow Up Again in Nostalgic Childhood
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40297204/553176535f5162dce0eb08d1ae72042bea1193e1.png[/img]

If taken back to the 90s, what type of person would you wish to become? Fret not, you can find your answer in Growing Up, a life sim game featuring a rich story aimed at bringing you an immersive experience! Come take a trip down memory lane as you revel in what the game has to offer. While it is still in development, you won’t have to wait with baited breath for too long: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1191120/Growing_Up/
[b]Growing Up demo is available now. Come and try it![/b]

The demo will feature the experience from birth to elementary school. Try your hand at the Brainmap minigame to earn attributes, go study a variety of classes, partake in activities, unlock new skills and locations, and mind you, the exam is a minigame in and of itself! Go make friends at school with whom you grow up together. Just remember, a single choice may change the course of their entire life! But that's just life in a nutshell, opportunity behind every corner.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40297204/9a71a664a087a1996a79e8bced24f8662a3ac8fc.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40297204/6eaed2e312eab4ec7a9edbd0cb3435f4de53f00e.jpg[/img]

And one more thing: As you progress the story you unlock random characters and locations, enabling you to visit a whole range of places. With each playthrough being unique the gameplay remains varied with a plethora of things for you to discover and try out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40297204/88c99a4289407a82d6d3359db5ca947e3f202f0b.jpg[/img]

Thanks for reading! Feel free to join us on Discord: https://discord.gg/xKGnmddMBQ

We will continue to try our best to bring a unique and fun game experience to you. Your support means a lot to us.

See you soon:)
